cases_page.seo_title: Software Engineering Case Studies & Technical Insights | Yesode
cases_page.seo_desc: Explore Yesode's audited engineering case studies and methodology: 62% production lead time reduction, 6.6x faster p95 latency, and 93% fewer order cancellations.
cases_page.subtitle: Strong numbers require technical context and transparent methodology. Below we detail the business problem, baseline scenario, implemented architecture, and how every KPI was measured in production.
cases_page.studies_desc: Real-world engagements anonymized under NDA, with baseline and post-intervention telemetry audited in production.

studies.title: Decoupling a legacy monolith into an event-driven microservices mesh
studies.problem: The financial settlement operation suffered from weekly release windows that required code freezes and caused frequent rollbacks, stalling the launch of new credit products.
studies.baseline: Tightly coupled monolith sharing a single database across 14 modules, slow manual regression testing, 1 deploy per week, and a 14-day average lead time from commit to production.
studies.solution: Applied the Strangler Fig pattern to extract Settlement, Reconciliation, and Risk into independent Go and TypeScript services with asynchronous Kafka contracts and automated Blue/Green CI/CD pipelines.
studies.measurement: Measured continuously over 90 days post-migration via DORA telemetry in GitHub Actions and ArgoCD: deployment frequency rose to 32×/day and change lead time dropped 62% overall (reaching 3 hours for core services).

studies.industry: Healthtech BR · National Electronic Health Records
studies.title: High-performance orchestration and resilience for 12M+ daily requests
studies.problem: Hospitals and clinics experienced severe slowdowns during peak hours (8 AM to 11 AM) and averaged 4 monthly downtime incidents when loading patient medical records.
studies.baseline: Direct N+1 queries hitting the primary relational database without distributed caching, no circuit breakers, and zero distributed tracing to isolate latency spikes.
studies.solution: Re-engineered the read layer using CQRS, event-invalidated Redis caching, cursor-based pagination, composite PostgreSQL indexing, and full OpenTelemetry observability.
studies.measurement: Verified via Prometheus and Grafana across 100% of production traffic over 6 consecutive months: p95 latency dropped from 1,200ms to 180ms (6.6× improvement) with zero SEV-1/SEV-2 incidents.

studies.title: Unified OMS and real-time synchronization across ERP, fulfillment centers, and channels
studies.problem: A 45-minute batch synchronization delay between the corporate ERP and e-commerce platform allowed customers to purchase items already sold in physical stores, causing a 3% cancellation rate and marketplace penalties.
studies.baseline: Point-to-point cronjob integrations and synchronous XML/REST calls without retry queues, dropping inventory updates during high-traffic promotional peaks.
studies.solution: Built a real-time inventory reservation and reconciliation engine using Change Data Capture (CDC) and idempotent message queues, ensuring sub-second stock accuracy across all 140+ stores and warehouses.
studies.measurement: Audited through financial billing vs. refund reports over 2 quarters: order cancellations due to inventory mismatch fell from 3.0% to 0.2% (-93%), directly recovering P&L margin.

cases_page.insights_title: Decision Guides for Technology & Business Leaders
cases_page.insights_desc: Original analyses authored by Yesode engineers to guide investment decisions in software architecture, legacy modernization, and AI automation.

insights.title: 1. When does your company need its own custom software architecture?
insights.summary: Off-the-shelf SaaS tools accelerate early stages, but become a bottleneck when your core business has to bend around tool limitations, per-seat licensing scales exponentially, or lack of deep integration creates operational silos.
insights.takeaway: Build custom architecture for workflows that differentiate your margin and retention; keep off-the-shelf SaaS only for commoditized back-office functions.

insights.title: 2. Legacy system modernization: when to rebuild vs. when to evolve?
insights.summary: Complete 'big-bang' rewrites fail in over 70% of enterprise cases because they freeze feature delivery for years. Incremental evolution via the Strangler Fig pattern replaces critical modules in weeks with controlled risk.
insights.takeaway: Choose incremental evolution whenever business rules are actively generating revenue in production; only rebuild from scratch when the underlying business domain has fundamentally changed.

insights.title: 3. How much does business process automation cost and how do you calculate ROI?
insights.summary: The true cost of manual processes isn't just payroll hours — it's data entry errors, delayed billing, and slow commercial response times. A well-scoped automation project should pay for itself within 3 to 8 months.
insights.takeaway: Prioritize automating workflows executed more than 50 times per week that require manual copy-pasting between two or more systems.

insights.title: 4. How to integrate ERP, CRM, and internal systems with security and consistency?
insights.summary: Direct point-to-point integrations fail silently when third-party APIs throttle or go offline. Resilient integration requires idempotency keys, asynchronous message queues (with Dead Letter Queues), and auditable reconciliation logs.
insights.takeaway: Never couple customer checkout or order capture to a synchronous ERP response; use asynchronous queues with automatic retry and reconciliation.

insights.title: 5. Artificial Intelligence in business: where is the real financial ROI?
insights.summary: Generic chatbots rarely move the P&L. Real enterprise AI ROI comes from agents connected to internal data (structured RAG), automated extraction of invoices/contracts, and assisted commercial qualification.
insights.takeaway: Don't deploy AI as a novelty; connect models directly to transactional workflows and measurable lead-response and conversion KPIs.

faqs.a: Yes. You can generate standard static Pix QR codes and paste both static and dynamic Pix Copia e Cola payloads to inspect and render them.

faqs.q: Do link QR codes expire or include ads?
faqs.a: No. Link QR codes encode your exact destination URL directly with zero tracking shorteners, no expiration, and no ads.

faqs.q: Can I download the QR code in high resolution?
faqs.a: Yes, you can export a sharp PNG image ready for print, signage, or digital sharing.

steps.name: Paste one or multiple links
steps.text: Enter URLs from YouTube, X/Twitter, Instagram, or Facebook (one per line) and click Add to Queue.

steps.name: Choose format and compatibility
steps.text: Keep Maximum Compatibility (MP4 H.264 + AAC) for playback on any phone and WhatsApp, or switch to audio/GIF.

steps.name: Download or send to Sticker Studio
steps.text: Click Download File to save locally or Make WhatsApp Sticker to crop it into a 512x512 WebP sticker.

faqs.q: Why is Maximum Compatibility the default profile?
faqs.a: It uses H.264 video + AAC audio inside an MP4 container, ensuring native playback across WhatsApp, iOS, Android, Windows, and Smart TVs.

faqs.q: Which platforms are supported?
faqs.a: YouTube (videos and Shorts), X/Twitter (videos and GIFs), Instagram (Reels and video posts), and Facebook Watch.

faqs.q: Do I need to install any browser extension or software?
faqs.a: No. Extraction runs directly in the browser with zero extensions, pop-ups, or registration.

faqs.q: Can I turn a downloaded video into a WhatsApp sticker?
faqs.a: Yes. Click Make WhatsApp Sticker on any queued video to load it straight into Sticker Studio.

steps.name: Upload a video or GIF
steps.text: Select an MP4, WebM, or GIF file from your device, or send one directly from Media Downloader.

steps.name: Adjust crop, zoom, and trim
steps.text: Use Custom Crop with zoom and X/Y position (or Top, Center, Bottom, Fit presets) and trim up to 6 seconds.

steps.name: Generate and drag to WhatsApp
steps.text: Click Create WhatsApp Sticker to embed official 0x5741 EXIF metadata into a 512x512 WebP file and download.

faqs.q: Why does WhatsApp recognize this file as a native sticker?
faqs.a: Because the studio injects the official WhatsApp EXIF chunk (tag 0x5741) into an extended VP8X WebP container at 512x512 pixels.

faqs.q: How do I send the downloaded sticker on WhatsApp?
faqs.a: On WhatsApp Web or Desktop, drag the .webp file directly into any chat. On mobile, send it to yourself and tap Add to Favorites.

faqs.q: What are the duration and size limits?
faqs.a: Following official WhatsApp rules, clips are trimmed up to 6 seconds and optimized to remain under 500 KB.

faqs.q: Can I crop and zoom into a specific region?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom Crop lets you zoom from 1x to 3x, pan X/Y coordinates, and resize the framing window with live preview.
